text:
```yaml
name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request_review:
    types:
      - submitted

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.7, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
        if [ -f setup.py ]; then pip install --upgrade pip && pip install .; fi
        if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install --upgrade pip && pip install .[dev]; fi
    - name: Run tests
      run: pytest tests
```
